verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's DuckLake lets users bring their own cloud object storage and set a DATA_PATH to their own S3 bucket, so users control where lakehouse data lives. The sharing docs also show that each Organization is tied to a cloud region. However, no evidence documents explicitly choosing a MotherDuck storage region or any data-residency guarantee. missing for 10: documented region selection at signup or organization creation, a list of available regions or residency guarantees for MotherDuck-managed storage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Spin up a fully managed lakehouse with MotherDuck handling both metadata and storage, or bring your own cloud object storage.
Sharing data publicly with anyone with a MotherDuck account in the same cloud region as your Organization
